data.title: Companion humanoid robots get lifelike silicone skin, 100 languages
data.description: Realbotix's Echo humanoid robots start at $11,950, with 39 degrees of freedom, optional on-device vision, and deliveries planned for 2027.
data.author: Aamir Khollam
data.keywords: computer vision, Echo humanoid robot, Humanoid robots, on-device AI, Realbotix, robotic companions, Robotics, social robots, Vinci vision system
